23:97.text: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,

23:98.text: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."

23:99.text: [For such is the state of the disbelievers]
until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back

23:100.text: That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind."
No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.

23:101.text: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another.

23:102.text: And those whose scales are heavy
- it is they who are the successful.

23:103.text: But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls,

23:104.text: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.
